purpose: Published whole-group Harrell–Davis P50 for educational comparison only; no new laboratory RI, exact-age model, fitted curve or clinical validation.

source.title: New liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry reference data for estradiol show mini-puberty in both sexes and typical pre-pubertal and pubertal patterns
source.sourceFormat: Final published article HTML and original supplementary DOCX

sourceLocator.statistic: Methods, Statistical analysis: Harrell–Davis quantile estimator for Tanner breast stages; Hmisc package
sourceLocator.population: Methods, Study cohort; Table 1 and annual rows in Table 2
sourceLocator.assay: Methods, Hormonal analysis; supplementary Methods and Supplementary Table 2

source.sourceTableImageReview: Cached official Table 3 image and native HTML agree on the B1 row; an image match does not validate the underlying author data.
source.reviewBasis: Complete primary article and original supplement reviewed, not abstract only. Fresh article and DOCX both returned HTTP 200 and are byte-identical to the 21 October copies. Three unique HTML tables each have four identical presentation copies; the copies are not additional participants.
source.statisticDefinition: Directly printed 50th quantile estimated with Harrell–Davis for the complete B1 1–8-year group; not a GAMLSS median at exact age or a median newly estimated for ages >1–<6.

sourceQuantification.belowLimitHandlingMeaning: The numeric substitution/exclusion rule for values below an analytical limit in the Tanner Harrell–Davis estimate is not reported. A median above LLOQ does not establish absence of censored observations.
sourceQuantification.cvLimitation: The reported intra/inter-assay CVs use much higher controls (0.75, 2 and 75 nmol/L); they do not establish analytical precision at 15 pmol/L.

source.redistribution: Factual table extract and source hashes only; the full article, DOCX and table image are not redistributed.

assay: In-house dansyl-chloride derivatization and solid-phase extraction; Acquity UPLC with Waters Quattro Premier/XE LC-MS/MS, MassLynx/TargetLynx
matrixLimitation: The reference is described as serum, while the analytical protocol covers plasma/serum and plasma calibrators. Individual specimen allocation for the 213 B1 participants is not tabulated; plasma validation does not prove equivalence of a known plasma patient sample with the B1 group.
population: Dziewczynki ocenione jako zdrowe z retrospektywnych próbek pozostałych po badaniach w Kiel, Niemcy, 2014–2019; stadium piersi oceniane przez przeszkolonych endokrynologów dziecięcych.

populationDetails.site: University Medical Center Schleswig-Holstein, Kiel, Germany
populationDetails.design: Retrospective residual samples before minor surgery or after exclusion of suspected endocrine or other disease; not a longitudinal trajectory or unselected community cohort.
populationDetails.exclusions: No active signs of endocrine/systemic disease; no steroid medication. Known contraceptive users were excluded where use was recorded; unavailable information does not confirm absence of use.
populationDetails.staging: Clinical Tanner breast stages assigned by trained pediatric endocrinologists. Source B1 maps to explicit Th1, not P1, age or an untyped Tanner number.
populationDetails.independenceLimitation: Tables describe individuals while Methods describes samples; no participant-level repeated-sample deduplication procedure was identified.

groups.label: Th1, 1–8 lat
groups.sourceAgeBoundaryDefinition: Printed 1–8 years; endpoint inclusivity is not separately specified. The application uses only its interior >1–<6; N=213 remains the full source group count.
groups.sourceRowWitnessMeaning: Literal full row retained for provenance only. P75/P90/P97.5 are not imported as RI, patient percentiles or thresholds.

unresolvedSourceFindings.populationResolution: No participant flow, exclusion or deduplication counts were found that explain the difference. Missing stage membership does not demonstrate an explanation; do not reconcile the counts by assumption.

otherRowError.label: B4
otherRowError.status: Printed nonmonotone; no numeric correction proposed, and no B4 values imported.

unresolvedSourceFindings.censoringResolution: Unresolved numeric handling of low values in the stage estimate.
unresolvedSourceFindings.matrixResolution: Unresolved individual plasma/serum allocation in B1.

selection.patientContextPolicy: Only current, explicitly typed Th1 of the same patient; no inference from P1, age, generic Tanner or an historical stage accepted only for growth calculations.
selection.preserveExistingReferences: Exact age 1 retains Ljubicic subject to its existing qualifications; age 6 and later retain Madsen. The group reference is not added to sex comparison, the educational curve or laboratory RI.

clinicalOwnerApproval.basis: Owner said “ok, zrób to” after a concrete conditional proposal that disclosed unresolved sample-count, low-result and matrix limitations.
clinicalOwnerApproval.scope: One narrowly labelled educational whole-group comparison for current same-patient Th1 at >1–<6 years; not approval of an exact-age norm, source discrepancies as resolved, assay harmonization or clinical validation.

limitations: 15 pmol/L jest opublikowanym P50 Harrella–Davisa całej grupy Th1 1–8 lat, N=213; nie medianą dokładnego wieku ani nowej podgrupy >1–<6 lat.
Tabela 1 podaje 1753, a Methods i sumy tabeli 2 podają 1724; różnica 29 pozostaje niewyjaśniona. Suma tabeli stadium 1064 nie rozwiązuje tej rozbieżności.
Tabela B4 ma nieuporządkowane centyle. Nie poprawiamy ich i nie importujemy innych wierszy; zgodność wiersza B1 między obrazem a HTML nie waliduje danych autorów.
LOD wynosi 4, a LLOQ 11 pmol/L. Nie podano numerycznej reguły postępowania z cenzurą przy estymacji mediany grupy; P50=15 powyżej LLOQ nie dowodzi braku wpływu niskich obserwacji.

Źródło opisuje odniesienie surowicy i protokół serum/plasma, bez rozdziału materiału w grupie B1. Znane osocze lub metoda spoza LC-MS/MS nie korzystają z tego profilu; nieznane dane dopuszczają wyłącznie ograniczone porównanie edukacyjne.
Wyniku pacjentki z nierównością nie zastępujemy zerem, LOD/2 ani LLOQ/2. Dokładny wynik nie jest automatycznie podnoszony do LLOQ.
Dostępna grupa nie określa normy, SDS, diagnozy, płodności ani indywidualnej trajektorii. Wynik i laboratoryjne RI zachowują własne reguły niezależnie od tej mediany.
